stem:
Manav wonders why rain that refills ponds and helps crops does not fall the same way everywhere.

Which chain best shows how sunlight, water, and moving air sustain life across Earth?

options.text: Rain fills ponds first; only then does sunlight heat that water to form clouds.
Sunlight heats water; vapour forms clouds; moving air carries clouds; rain refills water sources and shapes which plants and animals can live in a place.
Moving air cools the land first, which creates sunlight, and rain then falls from clear skies.
Because Earth has so much water, every place gets the same rainfall and the same living things.

teacher.key_rationale: Sunlight drives evaporation; air moves clouds; rain returns water and shapes habitats.
